theorems.name: Submission.cmcdt_ims_common_orientation
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : ℕ → IMRep U n), IsOpen U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] ((⋃ i, (R i).carrier) ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → ∃ (η : Euclid P → MultiVector P n) (s : ℕ → Euclid P → ℝ), StronglyMeasurable η ∧ (∀ i, Measurable (s i)) ∧ (∀ i x, s i x = 1 ∨ s i x = -1) ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (⋃ i, (R i).carrier)), ∃ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (⋃ i, (R i).carrier) x Q ∧ IsUnitOrientationOf (η x) Q) ∧ ∀ i, ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (R i).carrier), (R i).orient x = s i x • η x
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
